profile_md: UCL has no institution-wide employer-project requirement, but several distributed, programme-embedded routes where student teams work for external organisations. In Engineering, second-year BSc/MEng Computer Science students take COMP0016 (30 credits, 100% group-assessed), building a prototype for an external partner under the UCL Industry Exchange Network, and EEE final-year teams of 4-5 deliver company-mentored proof-of-concept projects; both are confirmed for 2025/26. The Integrated Engineering Programme's two-week How to Change the World challenge uses partner-co-created briefs and external panels, though current delivery is unconfirmed, while Scenario weeks are only occasionally employer-linked. In Business, the MSc Marketing Science 45-credit group Business Project works with external organisations (undated), and the PhD Data Intensive Science centre places 3-4 student teams on company problems. In Social Sciences and the Bartlett, the STEaPP MPA nine-month group project serves external policy clients; the Bartlett's Building a Better Future (June 2026, 83 students, teams of 5-8, briefs from AtkinsRealis, Buro Happold, councils) and the DPU Urban Economic Development London Project (2025-26 with The Fitzrovia Partnership) are confirmed current. The only University-wide routes are extracurricular: ExtendED International Industry Challenges (real overseas employer briefs, ~25 hours) and a researcher Consultancy Challenge. Grand Challenges x ChangeMakers is a student-staff partnership scheme without an external organisation requirement. Uncertain: current delivery for several undated routes and the share of industry-set projects in Scenario weeks and MECH0049.
gaps: Further departmental instances likely (e.g. other Engineering MEng group design projects, Bartlett Architecture/Planning studios, Medical Sciences, Pharmacy, Slade, IOE, Laws, SSEES, Life Sciences) not exhaustively searched. Several routes rest on undated pages (How to Change the World, Marketing Science Business Project, STEaPP MPA group project, UDP London Project, BASC0070). No participation numbers for most routes. UCL Volunteering/researcher-student charity challenge (June) and Newham Futures/UCL East Co-Design Lab activities noted but not assessed. 41 searches used (slightly over the ~40 ceiling).
